daffodil.zh: 送你一枝黄水仙，聊表敬意。
daffodil.en: A daffodil carries my warm regard.

snowdrop.en: Hope blooms before winter is over.

bluebell.zh: 任时光流转，心意始终如一。
bluebell.en: My feelings remain true as time goes by.

note.zh: 原书写通名 Bluebell，未注明学名。
note.en: The historical entry gives the common name Bluebell without a scientific name.

crocus.zh: 春日初开，正如少年欢喜。
crocus.en: The first spring blooms carry the joy of youth.

note.zh: 原书指春花番红花，藏红花另有条目。
note.en: The entry is for spring crocuses. Saffron crocus is listed separately.

iris.zh: 托一枝鸢尾，捎去我的消息。
iris.en: Let an iris carry my message to you.

note.en: The book uses the common name Iris.

tiger-lily.zh: 鲜艳的虎皮百合，有一份张扬的骄矜。
tiger-lily.en: The showy tiger lily wears an air of pretension.

note.zh: 1859 年英国花语诗集中的写法，由研究者转引。原书花名为 Tiger Lily。
note.en: A Victorian book’s usage as quoted in Stewart’s research. The historical entry uses the common name Tiger Lily.

tulip.zh: 一枝红郁金香，替我说出爱意。
tulip.en: Let a red tulip declare my love.

fritillary.zh: 方格贝母，在旧花语中代表受迫害。
fritillary.en: In old flower language, the chequered fritillary stands for persecution.

sunflower.zh: 一枝矮秆向日葵，捎去我的爱慕。
sunflower.en: A dwarf sunflower carries my adoration.

note.zh: 原书把矮秆与高秆向日葵分列，两者含义不同。
note.en: Greenaway gives tall and dwarf sunflowers different meanings.

daisy.zh: 小小的雏菊，象征未经世事的纯真。
daisy.en: The little daisy stands for innocence.

dandelion.zh: 把心中的疑问，交给风里的蒲公英。
dandelion.en: Let the wind carry your question to the dandelion.

note.zh: 据花语书的「乡间问卜」意象改写。
note.en: A line adapted from the book’s association with a rustic oracle.

cowslip.zh: 低垂的花铃，自有动人的温婉。
cowslip.en: The nodding bells have a quiet grace.

buttercup.zh: 金黄的毛茛，寄托生活丰足的愿望。
buttercup.en: Golden buttercups carry a wish for abundance.

note.en: The book uses the common name Buttercups.

windflower.zh: 林地银莲花，在英国旧花语中寄意病痛。
windflower.en: In old British flower lore, the wood anemone stands for sickness.

note.zh: Loudon 专指林地银莲花，并在书中对这条旧花语表示不解。
note.en: Loudon identifies the wood anemone and questions the old association.

pansy.zh: 送你一朵三色堇，愿你偶尔想起我。
pansy.en: A pansy asks you to think of me now and then.

camellia.en: The red camellia stands for quiet excellence.

note.zh: 原书限红色山茶，白色另有寓意。
note.en: Greenaway gives white camellias a separate meaning.

hydrangea.zh: 在英国旧花语里，绣球也寄意冷淡。
hydrangea.en: In Victorian flower language, a hydrangea can convey coldness.

note.zh: 原书用通名 Hydrangea，记有无情之意。
note.en: The book uses the common name Hydrangea and lists heartlessness as one meaning.

plum-blossom.zh: 凌寒而开，自有一身坚韧。
plum-blossom.en: The plum blossom’s quiet strength sees it through the cold.

peach-blossom.zh: 见你如见桃花，叫我心甘情愿地倾心。
peach-blossom.en: A peach blossom says that my heart is yours.

lotus.zh: 出淤泥而不染，守一份高洁。
lotus.en: The lotus rises from the mud with its purity intact.
lotus.locator: 莲，花之君子者也 / The lotus is the flower of the noble person.

osmanthus.zh: 桂花飘香，愿你蟾宫折桂。
osmanthus.en: As the osmanthus blooms, may you earn the honours you seek.
osmanthus.locator: 古代科举及第的象征 / The imperial examinations

note.zh: 这是后来的桂花文化借用「折桂」典故的寓意。古文中的「桂」可能指其他植物。
note.en: Sweet-osmanthus culture borrows the classical image of plucking a branch of gui. The term can refer to other plants in early texts.

tree-peony.zh: 一枝牡丹满堂春，寄来富贵好意头。
tree-peony.en: A peony in bloom brings a wish for prosperity.
tree-peony.locator: 牡丹，花之富貴者也 / The peony is the flower of wealth and honour.

wisteria.zh: 花串垂下来，欢迎远道而来的你。
wisteria.en: The trailing wisteria welcomes you from afar.

note.zh: Wistaria 是原书拼写，其条目指紫藤通名。
note.en: Wistaria is the spelling in the book, which uses a common name.

note.zh: 原书使用英文园艺通名。
note.en: The source uses the English horticultural name.
The meaning in the source is for white chrysanthemums.

note.zh: 原书用 Indian jasmine，属于历史通名。
note.en: The book uses the historical common name Indian jasmine.

note.zh: Cape jasmine 的历史花语用在栀子书页。
note.en: The historical entry uses Cape jasmine, a common name for gardenia.

ivy-leaved-morning-glory.zh: 在旧花语里，牵牛也可以指故作姿态。
ivy-leaved-morning-glory.en: In Victorian flower language, morning glory can suggest affectation.

note.zh: 这是原书英文通名的历史用法。
note.en: This is the historical association of the broad English name.
